title: 6 Bed · 3.5 Bath 3-Story Modern Scandinavian Residence
designer_rationale: The Side Gallery Circulation scheme delivers the highest overall score (90.4) while maintaining perfect privacy (100) and strong space efficiency (97.5). Its linear side corridor creates a clear, unobstructed path that enhances cross‑ventilation and frames garden views—key attributes for a Modern Scandinavian residence that values natural light, fresh air, and a strong indoor‑outdoor connection. Although its daylight score (85.7) is lower than the courtyard options, the generous glazing along the side elevation compensates by delivering ample daylight to primary living zones without sacrificing privacy buffers. Site-first planning with West frontage, 10.0ft front setback, and 6 bedrooms across 1780.8 sq ft.

construction_spec.reason: RCC framed structure recommended for 3-story residential building with span flexibility and seismic resilience.
assumptions: External perimeter walls configured as 9.0" (229mm) masonry for weatherproofing.
Internal partition walls configured as 4.5" (114mm) space-saving masonry.
Floor-to-floor vertical rise of 10.5' provides 9.5' clear head room after MEP/false ceiling drops.
Reinforced concrete slab assumed at 5.5" thickness with grade M20/M25 concrete.
Quality standard tier: Standard finishes and construction tolerances.

strengths: Efficient circulation with a single side spine
Cross‑ventilation and garden framing support Scandinavian biophilic design
High space efficiency (97.5) and furniture fit (94.4)
weaknesses: Daylight score (85.7) is below the perfect 100 achieved by courtyard schemes
Central atrium benefits (visual connectivity) are absent
Potential under‑lighting of rear private suites if not carefully glazed
suggestions: Introduce clerestory windows or skylights above the side corridor to boost daylight penetration
Add a shallow light well or interior glass wall to create a visual link between public and private zones
Consider light‑reflective interior finishes to amplify natural light distribution
